title: Nostradamus
summary: Michel de Notre Dame, better known as Nostradamus, was an ancient Casterwill family seer and one of the most powerful Seekers in the family. He left many prophecies in the form of quatrains for the Casterwills and the Huntik Foundation that would be key in preventing the return of the Nullifiers.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Nostradamus spent many years working in his tower, as a base to conduct his work as a visionary dictating his prophecies of the future in the form of quatrains. He left many artifacts in his secret room including his Scrying Glass with three Sentry Triclops Titans to guard it. [The Tower of Nostradamus] The accuracy of his prophecies led him to be branded a historical legend, however many accused him of being a fraud. [The Tower of Nostradamus]

Nostradamus would have visions of a Casterwill family traitor stealing the Ring of Kronos, the Legendary Titan of Time and would travel to Prague to warn the Casterwill council there. [The Power of Kronos]

Many years later, his tower was swept by the Huntik Foundation and converted into a museum. [The Tower of Nostradamus]

After Stack informed Wilder that the Huntik Foundation were investigating Nostradamus' quatrains, Wilder and his team planned to discover the tower's secrets. Unbeknownst to them, Peter, Billie and Annette were stationed there. After recognizing Hoffman from their files, Billie and Peter tried to stop the Organization team from accessing Nostradamus' secret room. However, they failed and were taken captive. They were later rescued by Dante Vale's team who, after defeating the Organization, recovered the Scrying Glass which translated the Quatrains and pointed them in the direction of Avalon. [The Tower of Nostradamus]

Lok Lambert and Sophie Casterwill encountered Nostradamus in person when they were sent back in time by Kronos and Dr. Benway. He and Viktor Casterwill questioned why they were attempting to take the Ring of Kronos from the Astronomical Clock of Prague and pursued them. He summoned Powerbonded Sorcerel but tried to prevent Viktor from harming Cherit and Sophie. However, he was overpowered by the corrupted Viktor but was saved by Lok and the Willblade who knocked Viktor out. After Sophie explained the situation regarding Kronos, Nostradamus invoked Kronos and sent them back home. It was only after returning home that they realised who Michel de Notre Dame really was and Lok was particularly frustrated as he had been so close to finding out the truth behind the quatrains. [The Power of Kronos].

On the longest night of the year, the Huntik team traveled to Nostradamus' Tomb in Salon Graveyard where they found the final prophecies ordering them to fly the Phoenix into the centre of the Spiral Mark and for the Champion of Casterwill to drive the Willblade into the mark to destroy it. [Words from Eathon] The prophecy later turned out to have been faked by the Betrayer and instead caused the Red Comet to change course for Earth, bringing back the Nullifiers in the process. [The Spiral Mark]

During the final battle against the Betrayer, Sophie used the Cypherdex to find Nostradamus' real prophecy that "the Betrayer fears his own medicine", which helped the Huntik team to defeat the Betrayer by literally stabbing him in the back. [Dante's Return]

Nostradamus was renowned for his remarkable ability to tell the future, for which he would use a [[Nostradamus' Scrying Glass|Scrying Glass]]. He also possessed all kinds of illusion powers, hiding his hidden observatory, scrying glass and [[Sentry Triclops]] Titans in plain sight. {{source|The Tower of Nostradamus}} He was also an immensely powerful [[Seeker]] as he was able to control the highly unstable Legendary Titan of Time, [[Kronos]]. {{source|The Power of Kronos}}
